review_description: They told me that I will own the solar panels after 48 months while paying in instalment and paid $1800 in advance.I will not have to pay anymore after the end of the installment period.Just at the end of installment period.Now I received an email from a company asking me to keep continue renting their solar system on the same price or less.I don’t own those panels they were on rent.My original rent was $184 per month.After installing solar paneling thought I will just pay the low energy bill which was around $60 to $80 each month plus $272 I was paying as solar panels instalment.I think these solar panels companies are liars.I will go to consumer affairs.

Thanks to Alan and the crew for making our solar Installation such an easy process. Alan is always obliging and available for queries and there was no disruption to our home and routine while the installation was done.Highly recommended. Looking forward to seeing the financial benefits.

Had an excellent experience with this company from initial contact and sorting out the paperwork and government applications, they also moved around installation dates to suit my work schedule, considering the problems they faced with Covid-19 lockdowns in Melbourne area I was surprised with their backlog to get it installed so soon, Installers worked between rain showers to keep works progressing to complete the installation, site was left clean. Note due to high demand for inspections there was a little time before an external independent electrical inspector could get to site to sign off works, (Not a fault of this company). Good communication and follow up after installation, and the extra time spent sorting out issues with power authority connecting smart meter for feedback to grid (I’m sure power authority delayed this to get some power feedback to their grid for free)
